select a.id,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.cover_image,a.content_html,a.content_markdown, a.category_id,ac.name as category_name, a.view_count,a.like_count,a.comment_count,a.word_count,a.reading_time, a.publish_time,a.update_time
from articles a left join article_categories ac on a.category_id=ac.id where a.slug=#{slug} and a.is_published=1
select at.name from article_tags at where id in ( select atr.tag_id from article_tag_relations atr where atr.article_id=#{id} )
select id,title,slug from articles where is_published=1 and publish_time>(select publish_time from articles where id=#{id}) order by publish_time asc limit 1
select id, title, slug from articles where is_published = 1 and publish_time < (select publish_time from articles where id = #{id}) order by publish_time desc limit 1

select a.id,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.cover_image,a.category_id, ac.name as category_name, a.view_count,a.like_count,a.comment_count,a.word_count,a.reading_time,a.is_top,a.publish_time from articles a left join article_categories ac on a.category_id = ac.id where a.is_published=1 and a.id!=#{articleId} and a.category_id=#{categoryId} order by a.is_top desc,coalesce(a.publish_time,a.create_time) desc limit 6
select id,title,slug,publish_day,publish_time from articles where is_published=1 order by coalesce(publish_time,create_time)desc

select a.id,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.cover_image as coverImage,a.category_id as categoryId, ac.name as categoryName, a.view_count as viewCount,a.like_count as likeCount,a.comment_count as commentCount, a.word_count as wordCount,a.reading_time as readingTime, a.is_published as isPublished,a.is_top as isTop, a.publish_time as publishTime,a.create_time as createTime,a.update_time as updateTime from articles a left join article_categories ac on a.category_id = ac.id where is_published=1
and ( title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.content_markdown like concat('%',#{keyword},'%'))
order by a.create_time desc

select a.id,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.cover_image as coverImage,a.category_id as categoryId, ac.name as categoryName, a.view_count as viewCount,a.like_count as likeCount,a.comment_count as commentCount, a.word_count as wordCount,a.reading_time as readingTime, a.is_published as isPublished,a.is_top as isTop, a.publish_time as publishTime,a.create_time as createTime,a.update_time as updateTime from articles a left join article_categories ac on a.category_id = ac.id where is_published=1 order by a.create_time desc

select a.id,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.cover_image as coverImage,a.category_id as categoryId, ac.name as categoryName, a.view_count as viewCount,a.like_count as likeCount,a.comment_count as commentCount, a.word_count as wordCount,a.reading_time as readingTime, a.is_published as isPublished,a.is_top as isTop, a.publish_time as publishTime,a.create_time as createTime,a.update_time as updateTime from articles a left join article_categories ac on a.category_id = ac.id INNER JOIN article_tag_relations atr ON a.id = atr.article_id where a.is_published=1 and atr.tag_id=#{tagId} order by a.create_time desc

select a.id,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.cover_image as coverImage,a.category_id as categoryId, ac.name as categoryName, a.view_count as viewCount,a.like_count as likeCount,a.comment_count as commentCount, a.word_count as wordCount,a.reading_time as readingTime, a.is_published as isPublished,a.is_top as isTop, a.publish_time as publishTime,a.create_time as createTime,a.update_time as updateTime from articles a left join article_categories ac on a.category_id = ac.id where a.is_published=1 and (a.title like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.content_markdown like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.summary like concat('%',#{keyword},'%') or a.slug like concat('%',#{keyword},'%')) order by a.create_time desc

select a.id,a.title,a.slug,a.summary,a.cover_image as coverImage,a.category_id as categoryId, ac.name as categoryName, a.view_count as viewCount,a.like_count as likeCount,a.comment_count as commentCount, a.word_count as wordCount,a.reading_time as readingTime, a.is_published as isPublished,a.is_top as isTop, a.publish_time as publishTime,a.create_time as createTime,a.update_time as updateTime from articles a left join article_categories ac on a.category_id = ac.id where a.is_published=1 and a.category_id =#{categoryId} order by a.create_time desc
